Ambient App

User Manual

📖 Product Introduction

Ambient is a Bluetooth app for controlling your car's ambient lighting. It supports multi-zone control, full-spectrum color selection, and various dynamic color modes and effects to suit your mood.

🚗 Quick Start
1
Install the app, tap the icon to open and run it
2
Turn on your phone's Bluetooth and the ambient light power. On first use, tap "Allow" when the app requests Bluetooth permission, otherwise the device cannot be found
3
Tap the Bluetooth icon in the top-right corner, select your device (name starts with LED); once connected, the icon turns ice-blue
💡 Tip
The app remembers your device and auto-connects the next time you open it.
📱 Main Screen
Main control screen
🎨 Color Wheel
The big center disc — tap or drag to pick any color; the outer tick ring syncs to the selected color
☀️ Brightness
Outer tick ring + white triangle, drag to adjust; the center bulb number shows the current brightness
⚡ Speed
Slider below the wheel, adjusts dynamic effect speed (only with dynamic effects)
📍 Zone
Switch which zone to control; each zone can have a different color
🌈 Dynamic Color Mode
Single, Twelve, Seven, Three, Red-Green, Red-Blue, Green-Blue
✨ Dynamic Effect
Breathing and Jump
🎨 Favorite Colors
10 preset swatches + R/G/B fine adjustment, customizable
Bluetooth Connect & Disconnect
Connect a device
1
Open the app and tap the Bluetooth icon in the top-right corner
2
Tap the search/refresh button in the center to scan for ambient light devices
3
Select your device from the list (name starts with LED)
4
Once connected, the icon next to the device changes color (gray → ice-blue); you can then control the lights
Disconnect & reconnect
1
On the Bluetooth settings page, tap the connected device and choose "Disconnect"
2
After an unexpected disconnect, the app automatically tries to reconnect to the last device
📍 Zone Selection
All
Control all zones at once
Front / Foot / Top
Control the corresponding zone individually
Door
Control all door lighting
Door Upper / Door Lower
All doors are divided into upper and lower areas — Door Upper controls the upper part, Door Lower controls the lower part
🎨 Color Adjustment
Method 1: Color wheel (most common)
1
Tap anywhere on the color wheel, or press and drag
2
The selected color syncs to the lights immediately, and the outer tick ring turns the same color
💡 Tip
Colors are most vivid at the edge of the wheel and fade toward white in the center.
Method 2: RGB fine adjustment
1
Tap the R / G / B blocks at the bottom right
2
Adjust the red, green, and blue values (0–255) with the sliders in the popup
Method 3: Favorite colors
1
Tap one of the 10 swatches to switch colors quickly; the selected swatch shows an ice-blue highlight ring
2
After selecting, fine-tune with the color wheel or R/G/B sliders — your changes are saved to that swatch automatically
☀️ Brightness
1
Press and hold the white triangle on the outer ring, then drag around the circle
2
The number on the center bulb shows the current brightness (0–100) in real time
💡 Brightness guide
Far right = brightest (100%), far left = darkest (0%), top and bottom = 50%.
🌈 Dynamic Color Mode
Single
Lights show a single color; change it via the color wheel or favorite colors
Twelve Colors
Twelve colors cycle automatically
Seven Colors
Seven colors cycle automatically
Three Colors
Three colors cycle automatically
Red-Green / Red-Blue / Green-Blue
Two colors alternate
⚠️ Note
Dynamic color modes work together with the Breathing/Jump effects, cycling or alternating colors automatically. When a dynamic effect is on, only the "Single" mode allows manual color selection — Single still breathes, but only varies in brightness on one color and never switches colors. In non-single modes the color changes automatically, so the color wheel and favorite colors cannot adjust it.
✨ Dynamic Effect

There are two dynamic effects: Breathing and Jump.

Off
No dynamic effect — lights stay static
Breathing
Brightness slowly fades in and out, like breathing
Jump
Colors switch abruptly
⚡ Speed
1
Drag the slider below the wheel — left for slower, right for faster
2
Takes effect after release; controls the speed of Breathing/Jump
⚠️ Note
Speed only works when the Breathing/Jump dynamic effect is on; when the lights are static (effect off), adjusting speed has no real effect.
❓ FAQ
Can't find the Bluetooth device?
Make sure the device is powered on and phone Bluetooth is on; move closer and scan again. The device name starts with "LED".
Connected but the lights don't respond?
Check that the selected zone is correct and brightness is not 0; if in a non-single dynamic mode, switch back to "Single" to adjust color.
Color wheel doesn't work in non-single mode?
When Breathing/Jump is on, only "Single" mode allows manual color; non-single modes cycle colors automatically. Switch back to "Single" to adjust.
Some Android phones can't find the device?
On Android 11 and below, location permission is required for Bluetooth scanning. Allow the app to access location in system settings.
What does the question mark in the top-right do?
Tap the question mark to view this user manual at any time.
⚠️ Notes
Safety
Adjust the lighting while parked; do not get distracted while driving.
💡 Tips
Allow the Bluetooth permission on first connection; if you cannot connect for a long time, restart the ambient light power and phone Bluetooth, then try again.
